name: Pesarattu
steps: Soak moong for 6 hours (or overnight).
Grind with ginger, chillies and a pinch of salt to a smooth batter.
Spread thin on a hot tawa, sprinkle chopped onion and cumin.
Drizzle oil, cook till edges crisp. Serve with ginger chutney.

name: Aloo paratha
steps: Knead a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.
Boil and mash potatoes with chillies, coriander, salt and spices.
Stuff the dough balls, roll gently.
Roast on a tawa with ghee till golden on both sides.

name: Rava upma
steps: Dry roast rava till aromatic.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, onion.
Add 2.5 cups hot water and salt, then rava while stirring.
Cover and cook 2 minutes.

name: Drumstick sambar
steps: Pressure-cook dal till soft and mash.
Boil drumsticks and tomatoes in tamarind water with sambar powder.
Add dal, adjust consistency, simmer 5 minutes.
Temper with mustard, hing and curry leaves.

name: Lemon rice
steps: Temper mustard, peanuts, chana dal and curry leaves.
Add turmeric and green chillies.
Mix in rice, salt and lemon juice off the heat.

name: Tomato rasam
steps: Boil tomatoes and tamarind water with rasam powder.
Add thin dal water, bring to a froth — do not boil hard.
Temper with ghee, cumin and garlic; finish with coriander.

name: Paneer butter masala
steps: Cook tomatoes and cashews, then blend smooth.
Simmer the purée in butter with chilli powder and kasuri methi.
Add paneer cubes and cream; simmer 3 minutes.

name: Veg pulao
steps: Soak rice 20 minutes.
Sauté whole spices and vegetables in ghee.
Add rice and water (1:1.75), pressure-cook 1 whistle.

name: Dal tadka
steps: Pressure-cook dal with turmeric.
Make tadka of ghee, cumin, garlic, onion and tomato.
Pour over dal, simmer 3 minutes.
